The '''Vasuuli system''' was located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Kliap sector/Legends|Kliap sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the site of the [[Vasuuli relay station]],<ref name="Planetnamia" /> a communications center operated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Wizards" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vasuuli [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-9.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
